theorems.name: Submission.cbr_isoperimetric_filling
theorems.statement: (∀ (P m : ℕ), ∃ c : NNReal, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ (ρ : ℝ) (K : Set (Euclid P)) (Λ : NNReal), 0 < ρ → IsCompact K → ∃ 𝒬 : Set (GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), 𝒬.Finite ∧ ∀ T : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity T → T.support ⊆ K → T.mass ≤ Λ → T.boundary.mass < ∞ → ∃ Q ∈ 𝒬, ∃ (R : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2)) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)), IsIntegerMultiplicity Q ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity Q.boundary ∧ IsIntegerMultiplicity R ∧ T - Q - S = R.boundary ∧ (Q = 0 ∨ ENNReal.ofReal (ρ ^ (m + 1)) ≤ Q.mass) ∧ Q.mass ≤ c * T.mass ∧ Q.boundary.mass ≤ c * T.boundary.mass ∧ R.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.mass ∧ S.mass ≤ c * ENNReal.ofReal ρ * T.boundary.mass ∧ Q.support ∪ R.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.support ∧ Q.boundary.support ∪ S.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * ρ) T.boundary.support) → ∀ (P m : ℕ), ∃ c : ℝ, 1 ≤ c ∧ ∀ Z : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1), IsIntegerMultiplicity Z → IsCompact Z.support → Z.boundary = 0 → Z.mass < ∞ → ∃ Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 2), IsIntegerMultiplicity Y ∧ Y.boundary = Z ∧ Y.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * (2 * c * Z.mass.toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1)) * Z.mass.toReal) ∧ Y.support ⊆ thickening (3 * Real.sqrt P * (2 * c * Z.mass.toReal) ^ ((1 : ℝ) / (m + 1))) Z.support
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
